other_failure_modes.name: Missing early stopping for boosting models
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses gradient boosting frameworks (LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost) with a high, hardcoded number of estimators (e.g. 1000 iterations) without employing early stopping on a validation set. This commonly leads to severe overfitting, especially when retrained on the full dataset.

summary: The solution implements a relatively sound pipeline, successfully avoiding data leakage by properly isolating transformations to the training split and utilizing a validation set to compute ensemble weights. However, it falls short in feature engineering by only applying generic encodings, and it evaluates stochastic models on a single split using only one metric. Furthermore, the lack of early stopping for tree-based models with 1000 iterations risks substantial overfitting.
